values.note: Operator's rates page: water & electric 30-amp gravel back-in $44/night; full hookup 30-amp gravel back-in $48, 30-amp gravel pull-through $50, 30/50-amp gravel pull-through $52, 30/50-amp concrete back-in $55; tent site $35. Rates include 2 adults and 2 children (extra $5/person/night); pets $5/dog/night; optional $15 site lock; 7th night free. Seasonal and monthly by inquiry.

fees.source: https://www.chainolakescamp.com/rates-rules ('Water & Electric Only - 30 AMP Back-In, Gravel - $44/night'; 'Full Hookup - Water, Sewer, 30/50 AMP Back-In, Concrete Pad - $55/night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online through the operator's Firefly Reservations page ('RESERVE NOW'). Without the optional $15 site lock the system may move you to another site. After-hours arrivals find their site on the check-in board by the office. Posted RV length restrictions (hitch and bumper included) are enforced per site.

booking.source: https://www.chainolakescamp.com/ (RESERVE NOW -> app.fireflyreservations.com) + https://www.chainolakescamp.com/rates-rules ('Site Lock Fee $15'; 'Adhere to posted RV length restrictions, including hitch and bumper'), read 2026-10-22

note: Campground at 7231 S. M-88 near Bellaire in the Chain of Lakes area; concrete and gravel full-hookup sites (back-in and pull-through), water/electric back-ins, tent sites and cabins, with a pool. Boat parking allowed at some sites if the boat fits on the pad. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's own rates page (2026): $44 water/electric back-in to $55 concrete full hookup, 30/50 amps with water and sewer, pull-throughs; reservable online via Firefly; phone (231) 533-8432 matches.
